exposure: Maternal BKPyV and JCPyV serum IgG antibody levels
Paternal BKPyV and JCPyV serum IgG antibody levels
outcome: Infant BKPyV and JCPyV serum IgG antibody levels
cohort: Infants were followed from 1 month to 36 months of age, along with their mothers and fathers.
finding: The study found a strong correlation in BKPyV and JCPyV serum IgG antibody levels between mother-infant pairs during the first year of life, indicating the development of children's own immunity and horizontal transmission within the family after maternal antibody decay.
